name: bp_cpt2
description: Automatically adds the CPT II and HCPCS quality codes for blood pressure (HEDIS Controlling High Blood Pressure and MIPS measure 236) to a note when vitals are recorded, for practices that report blood pressure control

protocols.description: Adds the CPT II and MIPS measure 236 codes for the systolic and diastolic blood pressure recorded in vitals
When a billable note is locked or signed, uses AI to link the note's hypertension diagnoses to its blood pressure codes
Action button in note header that links hypertension diagnoses to the blood pressure codes before the note is locked
